scope: Proposition 5.3 (Jets at the geometric generic tuple) of the manuscript “Maximal multipoint Seshadri constants in positive characteristic” (preprints/Maximal-multipoint-Seshadri-constants-in-positive-characteristic-October-5-2026/seshadri-positive-characteristic.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 039 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 ea4f7179e981b272), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 13. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let k be an algebraically closed field of positive characteristic, let X/k be a smooth integral projective variety of dimension n ≥ 2, and let L be ample. Put V = Ln. There is an integer r0 = r0(X, L) such that, for every integer r ≥ r0 and every real number 0 < θ <  V r 1/n , there is an integer N0 = N0(r, θ) such that, for every N ≥ N0, the sections of NL separate jets through order ⌊Nθ⌋ at some ordered r-tuple of distinct k-points, which may depend on N. For each such N, the same jet separation holds after base change to Kr at the geometric generic tuple p1, . . . , pr.
